I have identified the cause of the error reported in the issue. In `will_of_the_prophets/views.py`, the `RollView.get_context_data` method attempts to access `last_roll.embargo`. However, if there are no rolls in the database, `models.Roll.objects.order_by("-embargo").first()` returns `None`, causing an `AttributeError` when trying to access `.embargo`.

I have modified `get_context_data` to handle the case where `last_roll` is `None`. If no rolls exist, `last_roll` is passed as `None` to the context, and `board.Board` is initialized without a `now` argument (which defaults to the current time in its implementation, or at least avoids the `NoneType` error).

Summary of changes:
- `will_of_the_prophets/views.py`: Updated `RollView.get_context_data` to safely handle the absence of rolls by checking if `last_roll` is not `None` before accessing its `embargo` attribute.

I have identified the cause of the `AttributeError` in `will_of_the_prophets/views.py`. The `RollView.get_context_data` method was attempting to access `last_roll.embargo` without checking if `last_roll` was `None`. When no rolls exist in the database, `models.Roll.objects.order_by("-embargo").first()` returns `None`, leading to the error.

I have updated `get_context_data` to safely handle the case where no rolls are present. If `last_roll` is `None`, `now` is set to `None`, which is then passed to `board.Board(now=None)`. According to the implementation in `will_of_the_prophets/board.py`, passing `None` to the `Board` constructor causes it to default to `timezone.now()`, which is the intended behavior for a new game session.

Summary of changes:
- `will_of_the_prophets/views.py`: Updated `RollView.get_context_data` to safely handle the absence of rolls by checking if `last_roll` exists before accessing its `embargo` attribute.
